title: Viva Insights: Copilot Analytics Agent Dashboard for agent adoption and Copilot Credit usage
summary: The briefing's rollout caveat, licensing, default state and controls are supported by the current Microsoft documentation and supplied records. The changed licensing table still includes Agent Dashboard at the stated licence thresholds. Two admin paths need minor completion, but both reach the correct settings page.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: first row; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId AgentDashboard -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy disabling Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Agent Dashboard for all users in your tenant

```powershell
 ModuleId : VivaInsights
 FeatureId : AgentDashboard
 Name : DisableFeatureForAll
 IsFeatureEnabled : false
 Everyone
```

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard VFAM control supports tenant-, group- and user-level policies.
claims.quote: The AI admin can enable or disable the Agent Dashboard at the tenant, group, or user level using the Agent Dashboard VFAM control in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; controls[1].note; Governance controls: second row
claims.claim: Individual and group web-app access assignments are managed under Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard.
claims.quote: Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard.
claims.fix: Retain the existing path and complete it with '> Users or Groups > user or group > Add' for new access; for removal use '> Users or Groups > existing user or group > Remove selected users or Remove selected groups'. The existing route stops on the correct access-management page.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone disables the web app through a tenant-wide VFAM policy.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant

```powershell
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone
```

claims.claim: Disabling the Viva Insights web app disables the whole app, including the Copilot Dashboard.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: The AI Administrator does not automatically receive Viva Insights web-app access.
claims.quote: The AI Administrator does not have automatic access to the Viva Insights web app. To gain access, the admin must also add themselves using the process below.

claims.claim: Both the web app control and Agent Dashboard control must be enabled for dashboard access.
claims.quote: To access the Agent Dashboard, both the Viva Insights web app control and this control must be enabled.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy creates access policies using the printed ModuleId, FeatureId, Name, IsFeatureEnabled and Everyone parameters.
claims.quote:
Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy
    -FeatureId <String>
    -IsFeatureEnabled <Boolean>
    -ModuleId <String>
    -Name <String>
    [-Confirm]
    [-Everyone]

claims.claim: Up to 10 policies per feature plus one additional tenant-wide policy are supported.
claims.quote: You can assign up to 10 policies per feature. An additional one policy per feature can be assigned to the entire tenant.

claims.claim: User or group policies take priority over a tenant-wide policy.
claims.quote: Policies assigned to a specific user or group take priority over the policy assigned to the entire tenant when determining whether a feature is enabled.

claims.claim: The most restrictive policy wins among multiple applicable user or group policies.
claims.quote: If a user has multiple policies assigned for a feature (directly as a user or member of a group), the most restrictive policy applies.

claims.claim: The cmdlet requires Global Administrators membership or roles assigned at the feature level.
claims.quote: Currently, you need to be a member of the Global Administrators role or the roles that have been assigned at the feature level to run this cmdlet.

claims.claim: The AutoCxoIdentification VFAM control manages automatic access and supports tenant policies only.
claims.quote: This control supports tenant-level policies only, not user or group-level policies. ... FeatureId : AutoCxoIdentification

claims.claim: An exclusion-list policy must be turned on for the exclusion list to work.
claims.quote: To use an exclusion list, you must turn on the policy.

claims.claim: Tenants without a Viva Insights licence set minimum group size through Settings > Microsoft Viva > Microsoft Viva Insights > Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365 > Manage minimum group size.
claims.quote:
go to the Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Microsoft Viva Insights.
2. Under Copilot Dashboard in Microsoft 365, select Manage minimum group size.

claims.claim: Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility can restrict the Agent 365 view to public agents.

```powershell
 ModuleId : VivaInsights

```
